worldcombat.skill.tearfullook.summary: Well up and let a foe lose its fighting spirit, lowering its Attack and Sp. Atk at once. Its strength comes from your own wounds: the closer you are to fainting, the more it takes. The tears must be seen. Sobbing sweeps everyone in the fan in front of you, but winds up more slowly.
worldcombat.skill.tearfullook.use.0: Cut a foe's Attack and Sp. Atk while low
worldcombat.skill.tearfullook.use.1: Suppress the enemies in front while surrounded
worldcombat.skill.tearfullook.use.2: Buy a window to disengage while they hold back
worldcombat.skill.tearfullook.descriptio: A saddened target loses %1$s Attack and Sp. Atk stage(s) and stays disheartened for %2$s.
Tearful range %1$s; the sob fan is %2$s degrees over a %3$s radius, cast over %4$s blocks.
Tearing up takes %1$s with a %2$s cooldown. The tears must be seen; cover blocks them.
worldcombat.skill.tearfullook.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.tearfullook.preference: Off only tears up at one visible foe, fast and cheap; on sobs and sweeps everyone it can see in the fan in front, at a longer windup and cooldown, and it must hold its ground.
The companion only considers tearing up while a threat is within this many blocks; smaller cries only at point-blank, larger starts sooner.

The companion only tears up while its own health fraction is at or below this; 1 means it is always willing but the hit is weakest, lower saves it for when it is nearly down, where it is strongest but also riskiest.
In Sobbing posture, the companion only sobs with at least this many non-friendly bodies in the fan in front, so the windup is not wasted; 1 means sob whenever it sees one.
When on, the companion may leave its post to tear up under a Hold order.
